independent_math: full activity to features
YOLO rectangle to BoxEye mean retina
frozen linear readout to bearing
matched direct/alpha-beta outputs and seeded perturbations
capture/completion/release clocks
command authority and conventional autopilot rotor targets
mesh projection to evaluator truth
matched-subset RMSE and coverage
declared pause timing, expiry hold and fresh recovery
actual detector deadline rejection and preserved memory receipt
frozen_implementation_replay: actor animation and ideal RGB-D rendering
depth guardian and paired obstacle-free counterfactual

limitations: YOLO and recurrent Flyvis dynamics are not re-executed by this verifier.
Comparison streams store neural features, not full neuron activity; full activity reconstruction covers closed-loop captures.
Actor geometry/animation, MuJoCo and safety replay reuse frozen runtime implementations; they are not independently implemented engines.
Ideal state/depth, prescribed actors, approximate capsule contacts; no real-world or real-time flight claim.

No complete tracker anchor history is saved; current observed depth surfaces, selected detections and rejected detector memory receipts are checked, not every internal association. The verifier does not repeat the actual detector sleep.
This verifier also authored actor, depth helper and causal acceptance modules; those replay checks are not independent implementations.
Counterfactual captures are reconstructed with only obstacle mocap hidden at the same pose/time, while actual recorded motor targets are independently recomputed from actual safety alone.

media.scope: Saved-media decode, causal timeline, feature-array and exact benchmark-display verification; no model or physics rerun.
limitations: Sampled pixel checks reuse the exporter renderer.
Benchmark score mathematics is checked by the separate run verifier.
Browser interaction is checked separately by the coordinator.
This does not establish real-time or physical-flight readiness.
